; rm-ayah-toolbar: fixed-command hook in the open document's scene view.
;   ayahProbe                      -> JSON state + result of the last paste (read-only)
;   ayahPasteText:S:A[-B]|x|y[|st] -> paste surah S ayat A..B as KFGQPC Hafs typed text, each followed
;                                     by its Arabic-Indic number (the font draws the ayah ornament),
;                                     as its own paragraph near view point (x, y), in paragraph style
;                                     st = t (Title) | s (Subheading, default) | s2 | p (Paragraph)
; Text comes from /home/root/ayah-toolbar/quran-hafs-v22.json. Driven from the root-only xovi FIFO.

AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/DeviceSceneView.qml
    IMPORT net.asivery.XoviMessageBroker 2.0

    TRAVERSE ?#root
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            XoviMessageBroker {
                id: ayahHookBroker
                listeningFor: ["ayahProbe", "ayahPasteText"]

                property var diag: ({})
                property var quran: null

                function arabicDigits(n) {
                    return String(n).replace(/[0-9]/g, (d) => "٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩"[Number(d)]);
                }

                function composeAyat(s, a, b) {
                    const ayat = quran.surahs[s - 1];
                    if (!ayat || a < 1 || b < a || b > ayat.length)
                        return null;
                    const parts = [];
                    for (let i = a; i <= b; i++)
                        parts.push(ayat[i - 1] + " " + arabicDigits(i));
                    return parts.join(" ");
                }

                function paragraphStyle(code) {
                    switch (code) {
                    case "t": return ParagraphStyle.Type.Title;
                    case "s": return ParagraphStyle.Type.Subheading;
                    case "s2": return ParagraphStyle.Type.Subheading2;
                    default: return ParagraphStyle.Type.Paragraph;
                    }
                }

                function pasteText(s, a, b, x, y, styleCode) {
                    const text = composeAyat(s, a, b);
                    if (text === null) {
                        diag = { error: "range" };
                        return;
                    }
                    const c = root.controller;
                    // Enter text mode, then append at the end of the page's text as a new paragraph,
                    // so neither the paste nor the style change touches existing text.
                    root.moveCursorWithPen(root.viewToScene(Qt.point(x, y)));
                    const len = c.rootDocumentLength;
                    if (len > 0)
                        c.selectTextRange(len, len);
                    Clipboard.setTextFromString((len > 0 ? "\n" : "") + text);
                    c.pasteText(Clipboard.text, SceneController.KeepStyle);
                    const style = paragraphStyle(styleCode);
                    const cur = c.textParagraphStyle;
                    if (!(cur && cur.matchesButtonStyle(style)))
                        c.cycleParagraphStyle(style);
                    const after = c.textParagraphStyle;
                    diag = { pasted: s + ":" + a + "-" + b, chars: text.length, lengthBefore: len,
                             styled: after ? after.matchesButtonStyle(style) : null };
                }

                function startPaste(arg) {
                    const m = /^([0-9]{1,3}):([0-9]{1,3})(?:-([0-9]{1,3}))?\|([0-9]{1,4})\|([0-9]{1,4})(?:\|(t|s|s2|p))?$/.exec(String(arg));
                    if (!m)
                        return "ERR bad argument";
                    const s = Number(m[1]), a = Number(m[2]), b = m[3] ? Number(m[3]) : a;
                    const x = Number(m[4]), y = Number(m[5]);
                    const styleCode = m[6] || "s";
                    if (quran) {
                        pasteText(s, a, b, x, y, styleCode);
                        return JSON.stringify(diag);
                    }
                    const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
                    xhr.open("GET", "file:///home/root/ayah-toolbar/quran-hafs-v22.json");
                    xhr.onreadystatechange = function() {
                        if (xhr.readyState !== XMLHttpRequest.DONE)
                            return;
                        try {
                            quran = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText);
                            pasteText(s, a, b, x, y, styleCode);
                        } catch (e) {
                            diag = { error: String(e) };
                        }
                    };
                    xhr.send();
                    return "loading";
                }

                function onSignalReceived(sgn, message) {
                    try {
                        if (sgn === "ayahProbe")
                            return JSON.stringify({
                                controller: !!root.controller,
                                notePage: root.notePage,
                                textMode: root.textMode,
                                loaded: !!quran,
                                diag: diag
                            });
                        if (sgn === "ayahPasteText")
                            return startPaste(message);
                        return "ERR unknown signal";
                    } catch (e) {
                        return "ERR " + e;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
